noise_model.source: PhotonsToPhotos PDR.htm / RN_e.htm (series Sony ILCE-7M5_14, mechanical shutter; retrieved 2026-07-30). 2026-08-24 axis audit: the 2026-07-30 extraction decoded the chart x-axis as log2(ISO); P2P's PDR/RN_e x-axis is actually ISO = 3.125*2^x (verified against the chart's rendered tick labels and eight cameras' native ISO ranges). All curve x values shifted +1.6439 (curves now start at the native base ISO setting) and suspect_iso_min multiplied by 3.125. unity_gain_ev 8.76 = log2(432) from a first-party JPTC PTC fit (gain 4.32 e-/DN @ISO100, e-shutter, data/priors/jptc/), cross-checked vs P2P DxOMark-derived ILCE-7M4 unity ISO 427.8 (same 33MP sensor family) and vs the axis fix (7.16+1.6439=8.80, delta 0.04). The 2026-08-24 '3x fwc contradiction' first flagged on this entry was this same axis offset. suspect_iso_min 20595->64359 (= the ISO 64000 extended setting). Read-noise curve is MECHANICAL shutter; e-shutter read noise is ~5x higher (P2P ILCE-7M5(ES)_14, and the JPTC entry in data/priors/jptc/). 2026-10-10 applicability correction: structured mechanical scope for this combined entry; gain anchor replaced with packaged mechanical JPTC ISO100 gain 4.451971754176194 e-/DN, explicit reference span 15870.744766235352 DN. Earlier electronic gain anchor is historical provenance only; component_sources records the active sources.
